title: Sequencing: archive boxes
bodyMd:
Five archive boxes are arranged left to right in five shelf positions.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Aster, Dahlia, Iris, Lily, Rose.

- Aster must be in position 2.
- Rose must precede Iris.
- Dahlia and Lily must not occupy consecutive positions.
- Iris must not be in position 5.
